title: Quebec City & Montmorency Falls – 3‑Hour Private Driving Tour
blurb:
Discover the heart of Old Quebec and get the ultimate experience at the falls with Anecdote Quebec Tours. Led by your local guide Danielle with a deep love for Quebec city, these tours are more than just sightseeing — they’re passionate, informative, and deeply entertaining. 
Immerse yourself in local culture and hear countless fascinating anecdotes along the way.
Your local guide brings Quebec’s rich history to life with charm, humor, and authenticity. Dog-friendly tour (Upon request): This is a 100% private tour, so you can bring your dog along if they are clean and well-behaved. Message me before booking.
